commit.message:
chore: replace `| true` with `|| true` (#29842)

`| true` is a misuse of pipe and will fail if bash is configured with `set -o pipefail`. `|| true` acts correctly at all times and is better in semantic.

commit.message:
Add some repo URLs

in many cases just copies of url, partly automated

Replace gcc-libs with cc-libs everywhere

Except the provides in libc++ for backwards compat.
No rebuilds now, as that's not worth the resources.

NFC: Use MSYSTEM for build directories instead of CARCH and MINGW_CHOST

To be able to build for separate environments in the same machine.
Remove options that already set by makepkg-mingw
Drop clang32.
Add some CPEs
Some rebuilds 1/x

Make sure every package using a C/C++ compiler depends on one

The "cc" virtual package provides the environment default compiler.
Makedepend on autotools where needed
URL upgrades/updates/fixups
